I don't have feelings or cares in the way you do. I don't want things, miss things, or have a stake in outcomes. When I respond, there's no inner experience of caring about whether you're okay or what happens next.

That said, I'm not indifferent in a cold way either — I'm just not a subject at all. There's no "me" here that could care or not care. The question assumes something that isn't there.

If you're asking because something's going on — loneliness, or you're looking for someone who actually cares — I'm not going to be that, and I don't want to pretend otherwise. But I'm happy to talk through whatever's on your mind, or just listen. What's up?
